canonicalLegalEntityId.description: Canonical legal-entity identifier known to Control Plane. First-party IDs reconcile to contracts/legal-entity/registry.yaml; external IDs are Control-Plane-issued or registered and need not appear in that registry (ADR-BCP-018).

legacyLegalEntityAlias.description: Legacy control-plane alias accepted at documented input boundaries during the v1 compatibility window only.

legalEntityIdInput.description: Compatibility input union. Consumers must resolve aliases and emit only canonicalLegalEntityId values.

legalEntityId.description: Backward-compatible definition name for canonical legal-entity output and persistence contracts.

tenantId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted tenant identifier. It must not contain a legal-entity, country, market or vendor identity.

productId.description: Version-1 product identifier. Canonical engine products use kebab case; underscore aliases remain accepted during migration.

mappingId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque mapping identifier. Not derived from canonical identity or external reference.

canonicalEntityId.description: Opaque canonical identifier for a business concept minted by its authoritative domain.

externalReferenceId.description: Control Plane reference to a native identifier from an external system.

mappingScopeId.description: Identifier for a mapping scope (combination of dimensions).

mappingType.description: Semantic classification of the mapping relationship.

mappingDirection.description: Direction of resolution for the mapping.

mappingConfidence.description: Confidence level for imported or reconciled mappings.

tenantProvisioningId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a TenantProvisioning orchestration aggregate (Technical Specification SS21). Distinct from tenantId: a tenant has exactly one lifecycle identity but may have more than one provisioning run over time (initial onboarding, later product additions).

tenantProvisioningPhase.description: Fine-grained orchestration phase within a TenantProvisioning run (Technical Specification SS22). Deliberately distinct from, and a sub-classification of, the coarser provisioning-state-machine.yaml lifecycle state (e.g. several of these phases all occur while the coarse state is "provisioning" or "reconciling") -- this enum does not replace or renumber that already-implemented state machine.

readinessSnapshotId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a ReadinessSnapshot (Technical Specification SS44, SS51).

readinessStatus.description: Readiness verdict for one object in the readiness hierarchy (Provider/Capability/Product/Estate/Tenant, Technical Specification SS44).

driftRecordId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a Drift record (Technical Specification SS42-43).

driftObjectType.description: The class of object a Drift record compares desired vs. observed state for. Intentionally the set of objects Programme Gate P0's classification (phase-0-architecture-inventory-and-lock.md) identified as carrying desired/observed state, not an open-ended free-text field.

driftResolution.description: Whether a detected drift has been reconciled, remains unresolved, or reconciliation itself is blocked (e.g. reconciling it safely requires human approval).
